spectral_scattering.input: Current T1 native long/short logpower float16->float32, no resizing, fixed coefficients, all paths mean/std spatial grid

config.training: Full Train pure restoration, not minibatch continuation. Load the same V1global51 public task checkpoint and fresh S2 adapter initialization; keep TabM frozen. ONLY paired centered-direction cosine loss updates the adapter. No recognition or quantity-loss gradient, no classifier forward in a training step. Same row class budgets, online AWGN schedule/seed/order, two fixed views, normalization, adapter optimizer and20epoch budget as completed F1.
config.selection: Unchanged Val protection and epoch score: source protection first, then mean5/0ACC,mean5/0Single,rawACC; actual epochs1..20. Labels are used for existing class budgets and validation/evaluation, not a recognition training loss.
config.reference: Same Train mixture before additional AWGN, preserving native background and all Double sources. Reference only supplies the restoration target. No clean/count/SNR input during inference.
config.conditioning: mu1,log(std1),mu2,log(std2) computed from the CURRENT source-normalized feature vectors. No clean reference, true SNR or count is used by the forward. Output observed moments are retained exactly as in S1. These are feature-vector moments, not physical noise powers.
config.test_policy: Only if task and mechanism Val gates pass, evaluate six observed-input Test conditions with one sealed checkpoint. No automatic joint adaptation or architecture changes.
config.diagnostic: Partial clean-reference interpolation at the normalized input on Val5/0 only, never deployed. Fixed Train probes use stored waveforms with an independent fixed noise tag303; probe observations are not training targets. Train raw paired features remain training targets only. Forward has no clean/count/SNR inputs.
